chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd al-Khāliq, who said:

I asked him about a man who is among a group of people praying the obligatory salat, then a nosebleed occurs to him—what should he do? He said: He should leave, and if he finds water before speaking, then let him wash his nose of the nosebleed, then return and continue building upon his salat.

key_terms.أَنْفَهُ: his nose, the place of the bleeding
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat being resumed after purification
key_terms.فَلْيَبْنِ: let him continue from where he left off
key_terms.فَلْيَغْسِلْ: let him wash, meaning cleanse the affected area
key_terms.مَاءً: water used for cleansing the blood
key_terms.يَخْرُجُ: he leaves the prayer place due to the interruption

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he gets a nosebleed during the obligatory salat in congregation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who develops a nosebleed during the obligatory congregational salat. It states that if he leaves, washes the blood, and returns before speaking, he may resume and build upon his prayer rather than restarting it.
